name: codex-plus
description: Codex conversations in Agent Plus's work plan and Conversations views, a Codex session list, and a Codex button on the tab bar.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode nothing is installed into Codex, Codex is not patched and no file is written.

codexPlus.enabled.markdownDescription:
The master switch over the additions this extension makes to Codex: the time on each message, the list of your own messages, their colouring, the chimes, the buttons and the context meter in the message box's toolbar, the figures strip and the dot on a tab's logo, and whether Codex is patched at all. Off leaves each of their own settings as you had it, and turns them back on as they were.

It does **not** take an applied patch out of Codex's files. The patch stays where it is and nothing is drawn through it; `Codex Plus: Remove the Patch from Codex` is what puts Codex's own files back.

The work plan and the Codex session list are not covered by it, and have their own settings.

codexPlus.workPlan.markdownDescription: Keep a work plan for each Codex conversation: the open rows put in front of the model every turn, and the reminders at the end of one. Agent Plus draws the plans. Off makes the hooks say nothing and refuse to change a plan, and no Codex plan is shown.

codexPlus.sessionList.markdownDescription: Show the **Codex sessions** view in the Codex Plus sidebar: the conversations open in this window, recently closed ones, and the rest by Codex's own sections.

codexPlus.hideBackgroundSessions.markdownDescription: Leave out the threads Codex starts by itself - sub-agents and the reviews of approval requests - and `codex exec` runs.

codexPlus.recentClosedSessions.markdownDescription: How many conversations **Recently closed** lists. 0 hides it.

codexPlus.reopenDroppedTabs.markdownDescription: Reopen the Codex tabs that were open when the window closed but that VS Code did not restore, as can happen after the window lost its remote connection. Tabs you closed while connected stay closed.

codexPlus.tellCodexYourTimeZone.markdownDescription: Tell Codex the time zone you read in, when it differs from the machine Codex runs on, so it gives you times in your zone. The zone is the one Codex's page runs in. Nothing is said while Codex's own page has already told the model that zone in the conversation (it does at the start of every conversation it drives), so this speaks in `codex exec`, the terminal client, sub-agents, and after a compaction or a long stretch of conversation.

codexPlus.workPlanOfferMinTurns.markdownDescription: How many messages you must have sent before a conversation without a plan is offered one.

codexPlus.workPlanOfferMinToolCalls.markdownDescription: How many tool calls one turn must make before that offer.

codexPlus.workPlanQuietWhenReplyMatches.markdownDescription: A regular expression (Python syntax) tested on the latest reply. A match silences the reminders around a compaction, for conversations relaying another model's replies word for word.

codexPlus.chime.markdownDescription: With the patch: a short sound in a Codex tab when a turn there finishes, or when it stops for your permission or for an answer to a question it asked. Three notes is the permission one. A conversation with no tab open in this window cannot make a sound, since the sound is made in the tab's page.

codexPlus.chimeButton.markdownDescription: With the patch: the note button in the message box's toolbar, after Codex's permissions button, that turns the chimes on and off. It is struck through while they are off. Off hides the button and leaves `codexPlus.chime` as it is.

codexPlus.infoButton.markdownDescription: With the patch: the information button in the message box's toolbar, after Codex's permissions button, which opens this conversation's session information. Click a value there to copy it.

codexPlus.turnFigures.markdownDescription: With the patch: beside the time on each reply, that turn's context use, model and effort; and, at the right end of the row below the message box, the commands still running and the tool call running now, which is left to Codex while its own row for that call is in view. A turn's duration is left to Codex's own "Worked for".

codexPlus.timestamps.markdownDescription: With the patch: the time above every message and every reply block in a Codex conversation, in your own time zone, a message sent while a turn was running included. For a reply, Codex records the time on the block itself, and its own time under the reply is hidden where this one is drawn. For one of your own messages, the time comes from the clock Codex shows on hover, or failing that from the conversation's rollout, and is left off altogether when the rollout and the page disagree on how many of your messages there are.

codexPlus.conversationNavigation.markdownDescription: With the patch: a strip on the right edge of a Codex conversation listing your own messages by time and opening words. Click one to scroll to it, step with the arrows or with `,` and `.`, filter the list, or jump to the top or the bottom. While it is drawn the conversation keeps clear of its column.

codexPlus.userMessageColor.markdownDescription: With the patch: the text colour of **your own messages** in a Codex conversation, as a CSS colour, for example `#90EE90`, `lightgreen` or `rgb(144,238,144)`. Leave it empty to keep Codex's own colour.

codexPlus.userMessageEdge.markdownDescription: With the patch: a bar down the leading edge of **your own messages** in a Codex conversation, in the theme's focus colour. Off leaves Codex's own bubble as it is.

codexPlus.lowContextOutline.markdownDescription: With the patch: an outline round the context meter in the message box once 80% or more of the context window is used, which is 15 points before where Codex compacts it. It is this extension's meter while that is drawn (`codexPlus.contextMeter`), and Codex's own otherwise, which Codex shows only with its own setting on: in Codex's settings, General, Composer, **Show context window usage**.

codexPlus.contextMeter.markdownDescription: With the patch: a ring and the share of the context window in use, in the message box's toolbar left of the model picker. Hover it for the tokens in use, where Codex compacts, and what the conversation has spent; click it to compact the conversation now, which Codex refuses while a turn is running. While it is drawn, Codex's own meter is hidden.
